{{Quote|I'm going to enjoy this&hellip;|Darth Phobos, before her duel with Starkiller|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />}}
The '''Second Mission to the Jedi Temple''' was an assignment carried out by [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], to complete his training in preparation of facing several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Assignment==
{{Quote|There are more tests you must pass.''"<br />"''What tests?''"<br />"''Go to the Jedi Temple, do not fail me.|Darth Vader and Starkiller|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />}}
After [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] [[First mission to Raxus Prime|assassinated]] the deranged [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Kazdan Paratus]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] sent his apprentice to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] once more in order to prepare for his [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|next mission]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />

===Infiltrating the Temple===
{{Quote|The Emperor has decreed a quarantine! Stop and prepare to be detained.|An Imperial Senate Sentinel confronts Starkiller upon his arrival|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />}}
Touching down once again on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] landing pad that had been erected on the staircase of the entrance to the Temple, Starkiller eliminated the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] standing guard, which had been heavily reinforced due to his [[Starkiller's Trial of Skill|earlier visit]] (with an Imperial Senate Sentinel also attempting to arrest Starkiller on the spot before being cut down) and once more made his way to the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. Once he had passed through the archives, Starkiller was forced to make his own route to the [[Jedi beacon/Legends|Jedi beacon]] room, due to the large amount of debris in the grand hall that surrounded the archives. After dispatching the Imperials guarding its entrance, Marek finally entered the vast archives.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />

===Trial of Insight===
{{Quote|The scent of your fear is&hellip;intoxicating&hellip;|Darth Phobos to Starkiller|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />}}
While [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] had ordered the library's protection during [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], the Jedi protecting the four main wings of the Archives brought down the ceiling in the central atrium and a few of the archive's wings.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />

It was within one of the damaged wings that Starkiller encountered an incarnation of the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Darth Phobos]]. A hologram created as part of the Jedi Trials' line-up of potential Sith adversaries for [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] near knighthood, her [[Darth Phobos's holocron|holocron]] had been activated with Starkiller's presence, releasing the phantom form of the long dead Sith Lady. Engaging each other in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], Phobos often changed her appearance to that of one of the few people Starkiller cared for, Captain [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], believing that would hold him back. However, the young Sith apprentice was unrestrained by the illusion, and savagely battled the Sith apparition. Hurling busts and [[Holobook/Legends|holobooks]] around towards his opponent, Starkiller eventually pushed the Sith illusionist through four bookcases, as well as telekinetically slammed her against the walls and the ceiling after she attempted to throw her saber at him. Wounded, Phobos once again attempted her disguise in order to spare her defeat. Not fooled by the image before him, Starkiller stabbed Phobos through her back. Her image fading away signaled the end of the Trial.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Well done, my young Apprentice. You are ready to face a true Jedi now.|Darth Vader congratulates Starkiller on his completion of the Trial|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />}}
Immediately after the duel's end, [[PROXY]], Marek's [[Holodroid/Legends|holodroid]] companion entered with orders from Darth Vader. Starkiller then left the Temple once more to begin hunting down Jedi Master, [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. PROXY then admitted that he hated having to act as Vader's messenger, while Marek speculated being Vader himself.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />

==Behind the scenes==
This mission is only available for the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]], and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] versions of The Force Unleashed. On the [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]], [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] versions, Starkiller will head straight to [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|Felucia]] after [[First mission to Raxus Prime|Raxus Prime]].
